title: Bonded Specification — ambiguity layer (Case B: Strategy BTC sale market)
layer: specification (NOT verdict) — orthogonal to exp13/exp24 slashing

checks.what: Strategy reproduced: underspecified 'sold' is ambiguous (event<=deadline & disclosure>deadline -> two readings disagree)
pin to event-time => unambiguous (two readings collapse to one, disagreement impossible)
UNDEFINED leak: spec references a field absent in omega -> R=UNDEFINED
pin to disclosure-time also unambiguous (symmetry: fix is 'pick one', not 'which one')
n>=3 blind spot: unenumerated 3rd reading (settlement-time) disagrees even after event-pin
boundary inclusivity (<= vs <) at event==deadline is a separate ambiguity axis
oracle dispute: two oracles read same omega differently (measurement layer, survives a fully unambiguous spec)

summary: 8/8 pass. 3 UNSAT (unambiguity proofs) + 5 SAT (Strategy reproduction + honest boundaries). Bonded spec surfaces/prices definition-ambiguity BEFORE funds; it does not adjudicate the 'correct' reading, and does not touch oracle-measurement disputes or unenumerated interpretations.
